SELECT
  CAST(ABS(DATE_PART('day', (o.order_delivered_customer_date::date - o.order_purchase_timestamp::date))) AS INTEGER) AS delivery_time_days,
  AVG(r.review_score)::NUMERIC AS avg_review_score,
  COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS review_count
FROM
  orders o
JOIN
  order_reviews r
  ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE
  o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND r.review_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  delivery_time_days
ORDER BY
  delivery_time_days ASC;
